proposal.reason: Primary change is contribution/review automation: new `/merge`-driven squash-merge workflow, multi-commit squash-message generation/publication, shared Copilot automation scripts, and related contribution/review guidance updates. `ci` is also needed because `pr-test-ppu.yml` substantially changes CI triggering/selection and required-check reporting logic (edited/manual `pr_number` paths, job gating, concurrency, and when test jobs and gates run), which affects test-execution workflow behavior.
